## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows the commit convention, `type(scope): description`: it becomes the commit on `main`.
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes locally.
- [ ] New public items have rustdoc; changed behaviour has a test in `tests/`.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased` for any change a user can notice.
- [ ] No company, product, customer or business domain appears in code, docs or tests.
